summary: E2E tested New Salon Setup Wizard for fresh tenant (wizard-test-salon). All 5 wizard steps completed successfully, banner shows/hides correctly, backend /setup/status transitioned done:false→true, tenant isolation intact, and Miracurl regression (no banner) confirmed.

React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be child of <option>' from AppLayout — pre-existing, unrelated to wizard.

Step 1 Profile: phone (+91 9000000001) & location (HSR Layout) prefilled; edited location & next → advances.
Step 2 Services: setup-import-preset-btn added 25 services, custom 'Test Hair Wash' @ ₹200 added → count 26.
Step 3 Staff: added 'Ravi Kumar' / Stylist / 9111111111 → count 1; NO PIN modal appeared (as expected for fresh tenant).
Step 4 Hours: chip pick + next advanced.
Step 5 Payment: GST toggle OFF, setup-finish-btn → success toast '🎉 Your salon is fully set up!', navigated to dashboard, setup-banner GONE.

GET /api/services returns 26 items for wizard tenant; GET /api/staff returns 1 (Ravi Kumar).
Tenant isolation: miracurl-marathahalli services count remains 36 (unchanged).
Regression: admin@miracurl.com dashboard does NOT show setup-banner.
action_items: Optional: reconcile preset count copy — either seed preset with 40 services or update StepServices UI text from '40+ popular services' to '25+' to match backend.
critical_code_review_comments: setup_wizard.py progress.profile logic uses OR of logo_url with phone+location — fine, but progress.payment is (tax_enabled OR setup_payment_done); if a user later disables tax, payment step would flip back to false unless setup_done already set. Minor edge case.

SetupBanner does not refetch on route change — if user finishes wizard and returns to dashboard the banner disappears because it was mounted fresh; but if dashboard is already mounted in another tab, banner won't auto-hide. Consider a global setup-status refresh event.
